classification: Secondary observational reproduction; frozen after published summary values and baseline simulation were known, before pixel download and harmonic extraction. Not an independent new sky or discovery preregistration.

input.name: wmap_ilc_9yr_v5.fits
input.ordering: NESTED on disk; convert to RING with healpy.read_map(nest=False)

processing.mask: none: use the publicly bias-corrected full-sky ILC; do not inpaint or fit a Galactic cut
processing.remove: fit and remove full-sky monopole and dipole via healpy.remove_dipole
processing.beam: no deconvolution; symmetric smoothing rescales each ell without changing its axis
processing.numerical_check: repeat with iter=0 and 5; report axis/statistic shifts, no significance-based choice
processing.axis: same power tensor as null; independent NumPy Hermitian angular-momentum implementation and numpy.linalg.eigh; headless axes displayed in northern Galactic hemisphere

treatments.name: uncorrected
treatments.purpose: diagnostic for kinematic quadrupole sensitivity; ideal-null p is nominal and not instrument-corrected

treatments.name: DQ_corrected
treatments.purpose: primary within this secondary raw-map check
treatments.formula: subtract a_DQ(2,m)=T0*beta^2*(8*pi/15)*conj(Y_2m(beta_hat)) in matching temperature units; leading beta^2 contribution only
treatments.source: Copi et al. (2015), section 3.3; blackbody approximation, no frequency-dependent correction or satellite-velocity term

statistics.scan: max A_lk over the 36 ell pairs in 2..10; re-use frozen family null seed 2026101803 and N=100000 without tuning
statistics.uncertainty: report Monte Carlo Wilson interval, numerical extraction variation separately; no observational uncertainty inferred from MC error
statistics.axes: record all ell=2..10 axes and complex alm coefficients, input SHA256, size, source URL and software versions

exclusions: No mapmaking/beam/noise/foreground simulations, masks/inpainting comparisons, or temperature-polarization likelihood. Thus not an end-to-end observational significance or a global anomaly p-value.
success: Arithmetic and independent axis implementations agree; published rounded statistic is used only as a comparison, not fitted target.
